formulation: Prusament PLA; intentionally programmed active layer of direct-4D-printed spring; uniaxial reduction only
source_locator: Chapuis et al., equations 3–8, Table 1 and Table 5 row 1; SI Tables B.1–B.2 and WaveSpring/AbaqusWaveSpringInput.inp, *Material PLA_UMAT_Active (55 constants)
prestrain_class: Coefficient calibrated to bilayer curvature: 195 °C nozzle, 75 °C activation, 0.1 mm layer, 15 mm^3/s. Effective coefficient for this process; neither a direct free-shrinkage measurement nor a direction-independent bulk coefficient.
equilibrium_class: Source model coefficient in the example deck; SI table rounds this to 10.598 MPa. All 23 other branch pairs come from the grade-specific database.
characterization: 1–18 Hz tensile DMA and time-temperature superposition; not independent validation of long holds, solid plate bulk strain or multiaxial stresses
history_class: Designed material-point check, temperature endpoints in degrees Celsius and duration in seconds. Adapts the SOURCE NUMERICAL spring program to 23 °C instead of 22 °C to remain inside the characterized range. This is not a measured specimen temperature, oven or validation reproduction.
confidence: High confidence in transcription, no probabilistic uncertainty assigned to inferred initial strain or transfer beyond source scope
excluded: Do not add this mechanism to an independent eigenstrain describing the same recovery. Do not initialize ordinary unprogrammed production coupons with this coefficient.
